entities.summary: Jennifer Clement is an American-Mexican author. Clement has written several novels, including Gun Love (2018) and Prayers for the Stolen (2014), and published several collections of poetry and the memoirs Widow Basquiat (2001) and The Promised Party (2024). She is president emerita of PEN International, and was the first and only woman to be elected to this position (2015).
